title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter Solid Brass, Foxtrot Collection | Matte Black | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom towel storage with a wall mount towel ring crafted from solid brass and sized at a 6-inch diameter for daily hand towels in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting helps maintain a streamlined appearance.
  • Hardware included: Ships with the towel ring and all installation hardware.
  • Built for everyday use: Solid brass construction.

Specs

  • Type: Towel ring
  • Collection: Foxtrot
  • Shape: Round
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Diameter: 6 inches
  • Projection: 2 inches
  • Overall size (L x W x H): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Product weight: 1.6 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
